title: Double-counted orders after retry
prompt: A daily orders job failed halfway, was rerun, and revenue doubled for that day. Which 3 concepts best explain the failure and the fix?
explain: Retries replay work. Without idempotent writes (overwrite/MERGE) and clear checkpoints/offsets, at-least-once delivery duplicates rows.

title: One task runs forever on a join
prompt: Spark UI shows 199 tasks done in 2 minutes and 1 task still running after 40 minutes on a big join. Which concepts apply?
explain: A hot key balloons one shuffle partition. Skew detection/salting/AQE skew join spreads the hot key.

title: Job is green but dashboard is wrong
prompt: Airflow DAG succeeded, yet executives say numbers are from yesterday. Which concepts matter?
explain: Pipeline success ≠ data freshness. Track max(updated_at)/partition arrival and alert on SLAs, not only task status.

title: Queries got slower every week
prompt: A streaming job writes continuously to a lake table. Listing and queries crawl. Which concepts?
explain: Micro-batches create tiny files. Compact/optimize and target healthy file sizes.

title: Hourly metrics keep changing
prompt: An hourly KPI changes when you refresh three hours later. Events are mobile clicks. Which concepts?
explain: Processing-time windows move with arrival. Event-time + watermarks define when windows close and how late data is handled.

title: Revenue explodes after a join
prompt: Joining orders to order_items makes total revenue 3× finance. Which concepts?
explain: Mismatched grain multiplies measures. Declare grain and aggregate to the reporting grain before summing.

title: Overnight breakage after a producer change
prompt: A producer renamed a field; 12 Spark jobs failed at 3am. Which concepts prevent this?
explain: Contracts + enforce-on-write + registry compatibility catch breaking changes before fan-out.

title: Customer segment wrong on old orders
prompt: Historical orders show today’s segment, not the segment at purchase time. Which concepts?
explain: Type-2 history with surrogate keys and effective dates enables point-in-time joins.

title: Consumer reprocesses a chunk after rebalance
prompt: After a deploy, a consumer group rebalances and some events are processed twice into the warehouse. Which concepts?
explain: Kafka consumers are typically at-least-once. Commit policy + idempotent sinks prevent duplicate effects.

title: Warehouse bill doubled
prompt: Same dashboards, 2× spend. Query history shows SELECT * on a wide Parquet fact and full scans. Which concepts?
explain: Bytes scanned drive cost. Project columns, prune partitions, and attribute spend to queries/teams.
